subject: Problem using bootstraps from a nexus file with newick tree

messages.author: afd78140f75d39bc
messages.subject: Problem using bootstraps from a nexus file with newick tree
parts:
Hi,
Great package!  I'm having one problem.  I am importing a nexus file (from SVDquartets) with a tree in newick format and everything works fine except I cannot show the bootstrap values on the tree using ggtree.  There are several other similar posts to this one, but I still cannot figure out why it is not working for me--I am not using '$' within aes(), which seems to be a common problem.  I am still getting the error message: "Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (169): label, subset, node, x, y"   It seems that both the number of bootstrap values and the number of edges is 168--I can't figure out why it says there are 169.  Below is my code, and I have attached the R script and nexus file.  Thanks for your help!
Richie


MyTree <- read.nexus(file='508.tre')

gulf <- c(MyTree$tip.label[57:80])
atlantic <- c(MyTree$tip.label[1:56], MyTree$tip.label[81:96])
groups <- list(Gulf=c(gulf[1:24]), Atlantic=c(atlantic[1:72]))
MyTree <- groupOTU(MyTree, groups)
boots <- MyTree$edge.length
length(boots)
length(MyTree$edge.length)

ggtree(MyTree, aes(color=group)) + geom_tiplab(size=3, color="black") +
theme(legend.position="right") + scale_color_manual(values=c("blue","darkorange1")) +
  geom_label2(aes(label=boots, subset= !isTip) , color="black", size=2, hjust=-.3)

parts:

theme(legend.position="right") + scale_color_manual(values=c("blue","darkorange1"

)) +
  geom_label2(aes(label=branch.length, subset= !isTip) , color="black", size=2, hjust=-.3)

should work, as your bootstrap value was stored as branch length.
